This conceptual flaw caused the agent to bypass the correct investigation into the 1st Earl (the actual grandfather) and base the entire subsequent reasoning chain on an incorrect premise, directly leading to the wrong final answer.

hypotheses.rationale: The Planner incorrectly deduces that the 2nd Earl is the paternal grandfather based on the fact that he is the father of the 3rd Earl. This is a genealogical logic error; the father of the 3rd Earl is the father of the 4th Earl, making the 2nd Earl the paternal great-grandfather of the 4th Earl. This fundamental misunderstanding of the generation gap occurred before any final conclusion was drawn, preventing the correct search for the actual grandfather (the 1st Earl).
